content: Jefté, Galaad-neggweburginedid, bila-onogedgi dule-gandikidid. Galaadʼye e-bab-nugad, e-nandi gambasaedid.

Galaad, e-ome-sunnadbo masmala-nikusbalid. A-masmala dungusmargua, negyagi Jefté-ononnosmalad, ega sogsamalad: “Bipisaale be anmar-imbagi bab-burgwisad-sorba-ibmar-beoed-nikuosuli, ar bedi nan-baidid.”
Degidbali, Jefté e-gwenadgangi wakite gusad. Geb Tob-yarse megnad gusad. Agi, dulemar-gandikidgi-ibmar-atursamalad amisad, adi, e-sordaga-guegar. Amarbo ibmar-atursanaddaed.
Degi, ibagan-nasad-sorba, Amón-dulemar Israel-dulemargi bila-onononigua,
Galaad-sapin-dummagan Tob-yarse Jefté-sunad gusmalad.
Degi, ega sogdapmalad: —Anmarba be dage, Amón-dulemargi-bila-onogedgi be anmar-iduedga-guega, anmar be-abeged.
Jefté, Galaad-sapin-dummagan-abin sogded: —¿Bemarde isdar-an-daksamarsursi? An-bab-walik-gudii be an-ononnosmalad. ¿Ibiga emidi bemar suli-suli-itoalidgi be an-sudanimarsunna?
Galaad-sapin-dummagan, Jefté-abin sogdemalad: —Ar a-ulale, anmar bebina danimalad, be anmarba-naega, Amón-dulemargi bila-onogegar. Deyobi, bela anmar-Galaadʼgi-bukmalad-e-dummadga be guoed.
Jefté, Galaad-sapin-dummagan-abin sogded: —Amón-dulemargi bila-onogega be an-sedmalale, degi, Bab-Jehová Amón-dulemargi nakwega an-imaksale, ¿an bemar-dummadga gusunnode?
Geb Galaad-sapin-dummagan Jeftéʼga nue-sogdemalad: —Ar be-sogedba anmar ibmar-imakoed, ar Bab-Jehová anmar-barsogedga gued.

Geb Jefté, Galaad-sapin-dummaganba nadsunnad. Galaad-dulemar, e-dummadga Jefté-nug-imaksamalad, degi, sordamar-e-iduedga nug-imaksamarbalid. Degi, Jefté, Mizpaʼgi na e-ibmar-sogsadi gannar Bab-Jehová-asabin sogsabalid.
Jefté, Amón-dulemar-e-reyse gayaburba barmisad
A-sorbali, Jefté, Amón-e-reyse gayaburba-berbemalad-barmisad, adi, ega sogega: —¿Ibu-boni be anmarbo-nika? Emide, be an-yargi gwichigunaigu.

Amón-dulemar-e-rey, Jefté-gayaburba-berbemalad-abin sogsad: —Bemar Egiptoʼgi ainiarmargua, bemar an-ibe Arnón-diwar-akale, Jaboc-diwarse yar-susmalad, degi, Jordán-diwarse-bakar, be susmarbalid. Emisgi, nuedgi bemar anga we-yar gannar ukmalargebed.
Jefté, Amón-dulemar-e-reyse gayaburba-berbemalad-barmisbalid.
Weyob Amón-dulemar-e-reyga sogsad: —Weyob Jefté soged: ‘Anmar, Moab-dulemar-ibe, Amón-dulemar-ibe yar sussuli,
Israel-dulemar Egiptoʼgi ainiarmargua, nega-dulesulidganba aligusmalad, Demar-Ginnidye-nugad-naidse. Geb Cadesʼye-neg-nugadse noni gusmalad.

Degidgi, Israel-dulemar, Edom-dulemar-e-reyse gayaburba-berbemalad barmis gusad, ega sogega: ” ’Wilesagwa an bese egisye, be-yargi wis naega be an-imakena gadinye. Degi-inigwele, Edom-e-rey e-yargi-naega Israel-dulemar-imaksasulid. Deyob gayaburba-berbemalad, Moab-e-reyse barmilesbalid. Amba Moab-e-rey e-yargi-naega Israel-dulemar-imaksasurmogad. Degisoggu, Israel-dulemar Cadesʼgi ambikus gusmarsunnad.

” ’Geb degine, Israel-dulemar nega-dulesulidganba aligusmalad, Edom-yar-dikarba nasa gusmalad, degi, Moab-yar-dikarba nasa gusmarbalid. Geb, Moab-yar-dad-nakwedsik modapmargu, Arnón-diwar-obakar danar-danar ambikunoni gusmalad. Ar Arnón-diwar, Moab-yar-abingunaidga-gunaisoggu, Israel-dulemar Moab-yargi dogsasurmalad.

” ’Amba deyob, Israel-dulemar Amorreo-dulemar-e-rey-Sehónʼse gayaburba-berbemalad barmis gusbalid. Sehón, Hesbónʼgi-negdakmaidgi, Israel-dulemar weyob ega gayaburba barmisad: Wis an bese egis, be-yargi-naega be an-imakena gadin, adi, an-yarse an moegar.
Degi-inigwele, Sehón, Israel-dulemar-akudaksad, e-yargi-naega imaksasulid. Aka e-sorda-bila-onomalad bela Jahazaʼye-neg-nugadgi urbisad. Geb Israel-dulemargi bila-onosad.

” ’Degi-inigwele, Israel-e-Bab-Dummad-Jehová, Israel-dulemar bela Sehón-sordamargi-obinega imaksad. Weyob, Israel-sordamar Sehón-sordamar-ogalakusmalad. Degidbali, Israel-dulemar, Amorreo-dulemar-ambikusad-e-yar na susmalad,
Arnón-diwar-akar alid, Jaboc-diwarse. Degine, nega-dulesulidgan-akar arbalid, Jordán-diwar-maidse.
” ’Emide, Bab-Jehová Amorreo-dulemargi yar susad, Israel-dulemarga-ukegar. ¿A-yarde, bede gannar anmar-ibe subisunde? Adi sulirgebed.
Ar be-bab-dummad-Quemos bemarga-yar-ukedi, bemargadid. Ar anmar-Bab-Dummad-Jehová anmarga-yar-ukmogadi, anmargadmogad.
” ’Emi, Zipor-machi-Balac Moab-e-rey, abali ¿bede bur buledye sogsunde? Deyobsulirgebed. Ar we-reyde Israel-dulemargi gwen bila-ononai gussulid.

Ar bato Israel-dulemarde birga-dulataled-ilapaa-gusad-akale (300) Hesbónʼgi, degi, e-neggwebur-burwiganagi bukwamalad. Aroerʼgi, degi, e-neggwebur-burwiganagi, degine, bela Arnón-diwar-gakaba-neggweburmar-bukwadgi bukwamalad. Degite, ¿ibiga be a-ibagangi we-yar sussurmarsunna?
An gwen bemar-oakalossulid. Degite, bemardi angi gwichigu-nanaid. Degi-inigwele, Bab-Jehová, igar-naboged-dummad-gued. Emi-ibagi, Israel-dulemarga, Amón-dulemarga igar-nabogoed.’ ”
Degi-inigwele, Amón-dulemar-e-rey, Jefté-ega-gayaburba-barmisad gwen-itossulid.
Jefté, Amón-dulemargi Israel-dulemar-bendaksad

Degine, Bab-Jehová-Burba Jeftéʼgi ubononigu, Jefté bela Galaad-yargi, degi, Manasés-yargi nasad. Galaad-yargi Mizpa-neggwebur-siidgi nasbalid. Geb Mizpa-akar, Amón-dulemar-bukwadse naded, egi gwisguegar.
Degidgi, Jefté Bab-Jehováʼga weyob ise-sogar sogsad: “Be anga Amón-dulemar-urmaksale,
degi, Amón-dulemargi an nakwis-danikile, doa-inse an-abindakega an-neg-yawagakgi-nodagoedi, begadga guoed, degine, ogumakar an bega ukoed.”
Geb Jefté, Amón-sordamargi bila-onogega gwichiguded. Degi, Bab-Jehová Jeftéʼga Amón-dulemar-urmaksad.
Jefté neggwebur gwadulagwen (20) susad. Aroer-akale, Minit-neggwebur-naidse Abel-Queramimʼmobin neggweburmar-susad. Degidbali, Amón-dulemar, Israel-dulemar-sogedba nanabukwa gusmalad.
Jefté, e-sisgwaga naibid-dummad-uksad
Geb, Jefté bila-onodii gannar e-neggwebur-Mizpaʼse-danigua, e-abin, e-sisgwa dodoagwar pandereta-ogordanikid. Ar Jefté unnila wargwenna webi-nikad, ar mimmigan-baigan-sated.

Jefté deyob na e-sisgwa-daksagua, wile-itodedbali mor-yoid siir-siir imaksad. Geb weyob binnasur goted: —¡Bunor, be an-wiosdakle! Be anga nunmaked-dummad uksado. Ar Bab-Jehováʼga an ibmar-ise-sogar-imaksadi, an ega imakergebed.
Degi, e-bunagwa abin-sogded: —Baba, ar Bab-Jehováʼga be ibmar-ise-sogar-imaksadba be angi ibmar-imakodo, ar Bab-Jehová be-isdarmalad-Amón-dulemargi nakwega be-imaksad.
Degi, e-bunagwa ega sogdebalid: —Baba, unnila an bese ibmar-soggwen an egisbido: An sui-nikuosursoggu, wis nii-warbo be anga iba-udado, adi, an-aimarmala yalaganba an bodii sanaegar.
E-bab abin-sogded: —Degiir, nabirdo. Geb bunagwa e-aimarmala yalaganba nade gusad, ar agine sui-nikuosulidba bodii gusad.
Nii-warbo-gunonikidgine, bunagwa gannar e-babse nonikid. Degi, Jefté, Bab-Jehováʼga ibmar-ise-sogar-imaksadba ibmar-imaknonikid. Jefté-bunagwa bipisaale sui-nikussuli burgwisad.
Agala, Israel-yagana durdaksamalad, birga-irba Galaad-dule-Jefté-e-bunagwa-ebinsaega ibabake bonaddamalad.
